name: DAWN
missionStatus: Mission complete (2018). In orbit around Ceres.

model.note: Simplified visual reconstruction built in-app. Not an official NASA model.

briefNotes.text: Dawn did not land on Vesta or Ceres. It studied both from orbit, and remains in orbit around Ceres after running out of hydrazine.
